resources.string: Assistance cannot replace an attentive driver. Availability can change with speed, visibility, road markings, sensors, faults, or regional rules.
The related vehicle sensors and controller must be available. Changes that affect driving behavior are allowed only when the vehicle UX policy is unrestricted.
This assistance setting is currently unavailable.
This vehicle exposes no supported driver-assistance settings.
Park the vehicle to change this setting.
Illustration for %1$s. This is guidance, not live sensor data.

string-array.name: driver_assistance_descriptions
string-array.item: Helps reduce wheel slip and loss of directional control when the vehicle detects instability.
Can apply braking when a forward collision is imminent and the driver has not reacted sufficiently.
Warns when the vehicle detects a risk of colliding with traffic or an obstacle ahead.
Warns about a detected vehicle in a side blind spot; always confirm with mirrors and a shoulder check.
Warns when the vehicle crosses a detected lane marking without an intended turn signal.
May apply steering support to help prevent an unintended departure from a detected lane.
Provides continuous steering support near the center of a clearly detected lane.
May steer away from a road edge or adjacent hazard when an emergency departure risk is detected.
Maintains a driver-selected speed when road and vehicle conditions permit; the driver remains responsible for braking.
Checks whether the driver is holding the steering wheel when an assistance function requires supervision.
Uses available driver-monitoring signals to assess attention and readiness to take control.
Warns when driver-monitoring signals indicate possible drowsiness or reduced alertness.
Uses available driver-monitoring signals to assess distraction from the driving task.
Warns when the driver-monitoring system detects sustained distraction.
Warns about a collision risk while maneuvering at low speed; sensor coverage has blind areas.
Monitors crossing traffic when reversing or moving slowly out of a parking space.
May brake automatically to reduce a detected low-speed collision, but cannot detect every obstacle.
Chooses how readily lane-departure conditions trigger a warning.
Chooses the force of supported steering intervention; it does not increase the vehicle’s steering limits.
Selects visual, steering-wheel haptic, audible, or combined lane warnings when supported.
Selects how early a forward collision warning is issued relative to the detected risk.
Chooses how adaptive cruise control requests acceleration after traffic clears.
Warns when detected or map-based speed-limit information is exceeded.
Adjusts the threshold above or below the detected speed limit before a warning is issued.
Sets the level for driver-assistance warnings without changing media or call volume.
Enables obstacle sensing and warnings for the front parking zone during low-speed maneuvers.
Enables obstacle sensing and warnings for the rear parking zone during low-speed maneuvers.
Sets the level for parking-distance warnings; visual distance information remains available when supported.
Warns occupants when opening a door could conflict with approaching traffic or cyclists.
Applies a coordinated comfort, balanced, proactive, or custom set of assistance preferences.
